title: Enable package validation against the 1.0.0 baseline
lead: Neither csproj sets `EnablePackageValidation` or a baseline, so nothing mechanically checks the 1.x API promise (no removals, renames or signature breaks; `ProfileOptions.Create` frozen). After 1.0.0 is on nuget.org, enable package validation for squalor.squalify with `PackageValidationBaselineVersion` 1.0.0 so a 1.x change that breaks the public API fails `pack`. Ask the owner first: it fetches the baseline package from nuget.org during the build (a network dependency in CI and local builds), and the positional records (Issue, EncodingSection, Limits, RowClassesInfo) may legitimately gain trailing members, which validation would flag.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Owner decision on the network fetch and on suppressions for the positional records; 2. enable validation with a suppression file; 3. a failing check: a scratch removal of a public member fails pack; 4. docs (CONTRIBUTING, release.md).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; pack passes; `slicer check` passes.
